list.title: My events
list.subtitle: Create your event pages on events.taghunter.fr and sell tickets online.
list.empty: No events yet. Create your first one!
list.confirmDelete: Delete "{{title}}"? An event that already has bookings is archived instead of deleted.
list.archived: The event had bookings: it was archived.

editor.unpublished: The event is back to draft.
editor.notReady: A few things left before publishing:

checklist.title: Give the event a title (Page tab, main language).
checklist.terms: Add your rules or terms of sale: text (Page tab) or PDF (Booking tab).
checklist.venue: Enter at least the venue's city (Settings tab).
checklist.ticket_types: Create at least one ticket type (Tickets & pricing tab).
checklist.slots: Add at least one upcoming, open session that sells a ticket (Sessions tab).
checklist.stripe: Connect an active Stripe account to sell paid tickets (Payments page).
checklist.ready: Everything is ready: you can publish.

page.languageHelp: Fields left empty in a language use the main language's text.
page.title: Title
page.subtitle: Tagline
page.markdownHelp: Formatting: **bold**, *italic*, lists with "- ", blank lines between paragraphs.
page.author: Name
page.question: Question
page.termsHelp: Buyers must accept them to book. You can also attach a PDF in the Booking tab.
page.seo: Description for Google and social networks
page.seoHelp: About 150 characters. Otherwise the tagline is used.
page.sectionsHelp: Tick the sections to show and set their order.
page.countdown: Show a countdown to the first session

tickets.title: Ticket types
tickets.help: Each ticket is one person. A booking forms one team with its "player" tickets.
tickets.label: Ticket name ({{lang}})
tickets.roleHelp: "Individual": a role booked alone (zombie, volunteer…), never turned into a team in Playground.
tickets.priceHelp: Applies once every tier has ended.
tickets.inactiveHelp: Tickets taken off sale stay on existing bookings.
tickets.tiersHelp: Cheaper prices early on: a tier applies until its end date or until N tickets of this type are sold, whichever comes first. Then the next tier, then the regular price.
tickets.tierNeedsEnd: A tier needs an end date or a number of tickets.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.help: A session = a start time with its capacity (in people) and the tickets it sells. Times in the {{tz}} time zone.
sessions.empty: No session. Use the generator below or add one.
sessions.label: Label
sessions.hasBookings: A session with bookings can't be deleted: close it instead.
sessions.generatorHelp: Creates a session every N minutes between two times on the same day.
sessions.gameHelp: The game played in this session: Playground suggests it first for "Load teams".

checkout.requireDetails: Ask for each participant's first name and age
checkout.requireDetailsHelp: Needed to check minimum ages and the accompaniment rule. Otherwise the buyer simply confirms that all participants meet the age requirements.
checkout.minorRuleSuffix: must be accompanied by an adult aged
checkout.minorRuleSuffix2: or over in the same booking
checkout.refundHelp: Shown before payment. The booking fee is not refunded unless you cancel the session.
checkout.availabilityStatus: Status only (Available / Few places left / Full)
checkout.imageRights: Ask for image-rights consent (optional for the buyer)
checkout.termsText: The rules text is entered in the Page tab (per language).
checkout.questionsHelp: Up to 5 questions asked to the buyer (allergies, T-shirt size…).

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.help: Click a booking to see it in full, edit, refund or cancel it.

settings.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Changing the address breaks links already shared.
settings.geoHelp: Optional: shows the exact spot on the map (right-click in OpenStreetMap or Google Maps to copy the coordinates).
settings.listed: Show the event in the events.taghunter.fr directory
settings.listedHelp: Otherwise the page is only reachable through its link.
settings.alertEmail: Get an email for each booking
settings.alertEmailHelp: Leave empty to get no alerts.

errors.slug_invalid: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes only.
errors.below_min: Must be greater than or equal to the minimum.
errors.below_taken: Lower than the places already taken.
errors.invalid_image: Image not recognised (PNG, JPEG or WebP).
errors.not_an_event_language: This language isn't enabled for the event.
errors.events_disabled: Ticketing isn't enabled on your account.
errors.not_refundable_online: This booking was not paid online.
errors.not_sendable: No email can be sent for this booking.
errors.type_sold_out: Not enough places for this ticket.
errors.not_sold_on_slot: Ticket not sold on this session.
errors.too_many_links: You already have 20 links: delete one before creating another.

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.help: Extras sold with the ticket and chosen during booking: T-shirt, souvenir photo, snack… Their price is added to the total.
addons.label: Add-on name ({{lang}})
addons.variantsHelp: Variants are for sizes, colours… For a simple add-on, keep a single unnamed variant. Stock is tracked per variant (empty = unlimited).

promo.title: Promo codes
promo.help: Discounts in % or euros on tickets and add-ons. The booking fee is calculated after the discount.
promo.usedRemoveHelp: A code that was used is switched off rather than deleted.
promo.note: Codes are not case-sensitive. A booking being paid counts as a use until it expires.

cancel.reasonHelp: For example: weather warning, technical problem…
cancel.banner: This event was cancelled on {{date}}: sales are stopped and buyers refunded.

job.done: Cancellation finished: every buyer was refunded and notified.
job.error: Cancellation finished with errors: some refunds failed.

cancel_slot.title: Cancel the session
cancel_slot.label: Session of {{when}} ({{count}} place(s) booked)
cancel_slot.warning: Every booking of this session will be cancelled. Online buyers get a full refund, booking fee included, and an email. This cannot be undone.

cancel_event.title: Cancel the event
cancel_event.label: Cancel the whole event ({{count}} active booking(s))
cancel_event.help: Stops sales, cancels every session and fully refunds every online buyer, booking fee included.
cancel_event.warning: Every session and booking will be cancelled. Online buyers get a full refund, booking fee included, and an email. This cannot be undone.

drawer.disputeHelp: The buyer disputed this payment with their bank. Respond from your Stripe dashboard (Disputes) before the deadline.
drawer.offlineHelp: Booking entered by you: the money doesn't go through Stripe, no booking fee.
drawer.manageLinkHelp: The link sent to the buyer: their ticket, and they can fix names until sales close.

log.paid_after_sold_out: Paid after expiry, session full: refunded

drawer.refundHelp: Up to {{max}}. The booking fee ({{fee}}) is never refunded by the organiser. The refund goes through your Stripe account.
drawer.cancelHelp: The places are freed. A cancelled booking can't be restored.
drawer.cancelPendingHelp: The payment isn't finished: the places are freed and the payment in progress is dropped.
drawer.feeKept: The booking fee is not refunded.

manual.title: Add a booking
manual.help: For an on-site sale, a group paid on invoice or an invitation. It counts against the session capacity, with no booking fee.
manual.soldOut: Not enough places on this session ({{count}} left).
manual.typeSoldOut: Not enough places for this ticket type on this session.
manual.noTypes: No ticket is sold on this session.
manual.priceHelp: The amount uses the current prices.
manual.sendEmail: Send the confirmation email with the QR code
manual.sendEmailNeedsEmail: Enter an email address to send it.

checkin.title: Event-day check-in
checkin.help: Check people in from your phone: scan the ticket QR code or search a name. Arrivals also show in Playground.
checkin.staffHelp: Share the link and the code with your volunteers. They see names and can check people in, without access to amounts or contact details.
checkin.pinOnce: Write the code down now: it won't be shown again. If it's lost, generate a new one.
checkin.shareText: Participant check-in: open {{url}} on your phone and enter the code {{pin}}.
checkin.revokeText: The link "{{label}}" will stop working and volunteers using it will be signed out.
